# 1. Set directory

```{r set_dir, echo=TRUE}

wd <- getwd()

target_tissue <- "gas"

date <- Sys.Date()
                                
dir.rds <- file.path(wd, "rds", target_tissue)
if(!dir.exists(dir.rds)) {dir.create(dir.rds, recursive = TRUE)}

dir.output <- file.path(wd, "output", target_tissue, date)
if(!dir.exists(dir.output)) {dir.create(dir.output, recursive = TRUE)}


data.mRNA <- read.csv("F:/wd/Mm_Bulk_RNA-seq/dataset/data_norm_adj.csv", 
                     header = TRUE
                     )

```

# 2. Library

```{r library, echo=TRUE}

library(ggplot2)
library(tidyverse)
library(dplyr)
```

# 3. Arrange data format

```{r arrange_format, echo=TRUE}

data.mRNA <- as.data.frame(data.mRNA) %>% 
  column_to_rownames(var = "gene_symbol")


# Select mRNA detected in mRNA-seq of several tissues from DIO mice
prefixes <- sub("_.*", "", colnames(data.mRNA))
split_matrices <- split(seq_along(prefixes), prefixes)

list.mRNA <- lapply(split_matrices, function(cols) {
  data.mRNA[, cols, drop = FALSE]
})

list.mRNA.selected <- lapply(names(list.mRNA), function(tissue) {
  mat <- list.mRNA[[tissue]]
  timepoints <- c("0d", "1d", "3d", "1w", "2w", "4w", "6w", "8w", "10w", "12w")
  pattern <- paste0("^", tissue, "_(", paste(timepoints, collapse = "|"), ")_")
  selected_cols <- str_detect(colnames(mat), pattern)
  mat[, selected_cols, drop = FALSE]
})

# Preserve tissue names
names(list.mRNA.selected) <- names(list.mRNA)

```

# 4. mRNA in target tissue

```{r data_arrange, echo=TRUE}

mRNA.target_tissue <- 
  list.mRNA.selected[[target_tissue]] %>% 
  as.data.frame() %>% 
  rownames_to_column(var = "symbol") %>% 
  pivot_longer(
    cols = -symbol,
    names_to = "sample.ID",
    values_to = "Log2TPM"
  )


mRNA.target_tissue <- mRNA.target_tissue %>% 
  mutate(timepoint = sub("(\\w+)_.*", "\\1", sample.ID)) 
  
mRNA.target_tissue <- mRNA.target_tissue %>% 
  mutate(
    timepoint = timepoint %>% 
      str_remove(paste0("^",target_tissue,"_")) %>% 
      str_replace("w$", "wk")
  )

mRNA.target_tissue$timepoint <- 
  factor(
    mRNA.target_tissue$timepoint,
    levels = c("0d", "1d", "3d", "1wk", "2wk", 
               "4wk", "6wk", "8wk", "10wk", "12wk")
    )

# Filter genes: keep only those with none zeros per timepoint
genes_with_zeros <- 
  mRNA.target_tissue %>%
  group_by(symbol, timepoint) %>%
  summarise(has_zero = any(Log2TPM == 0), .groups = "drop") %>%
  group_by(symbol) %>%
  summarise(any_zero = any(has_zero), .groups = "drop") %>%
  filter(any_zero) %>% 
  pull(symbol)
  
mRNA.filtered <- 
  mRNA.target_tissue %>% 
  filter(!symbol %in% genes_with_zeros)
  
keep.genes <- unique(mRNA.filtered$symbol)

mRNA.anno <- 
  AnnotationDbi::select(
    x = org.Mm.eg.db,
    keys = unique(mRNA.filtered$symbol),
    columns = c("ENTREZID", "GENENAME"),
    keytype = "SYMBOL"
    )
colnames(mRNA.anno) <- c("symbol", "entrezid", "genename")

mRNA.filtered <- 
  left_join(
    x = mRNA.filtered,
    y = mRNA.anno,
    by = "symbol"
  )

p1 <- ggplot(mRNA.filtered, aes(x = sample.ID, y = Log2TPM)) +
  geom_boxplot(outlier.shape = TRUE, fill = "lightblue") +
  #theme_minimal() +
  theme(axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 90, hjust = 1),
        plot.title = element_text(size = 14, face = "bold")) +
  labs(title = "Distribution of Log2TPM Across Samples",
       x = "Sample ID",
       y = "Log2TPM")


p1

write.csv(mRNA.filtered , file = file.path(dir.output, paste0(target_tissue, "_nonzero_Log2TPM.csv")))
```

# 5. maSigPro: DEG in series samples

```{r maSigPro, echo=TRUE}

edesign <- 
  data.frame(
    Time = rep(c(0,1,3,7,14,28,42,56,70,84), each = 6),
    Replicate = rep(c(1:10), each = 6),
    Group = rep(1,12)
    )

rownames(edesign) <- colnames(list.mRNA.selected[[target_tissue]])

# rescaling time point between 0-1
edesign$Time <- edesign$Time/max(edesign$Time)



# maSigPro
edesign <- make.design.matrix(edesign, degree = 3) ## Cubic model: Degree 3–4: can model more complex dynamics (e.g., up-down-up)

# Estimate the Condition Number of a Matrix
## result is ideally less than 100
kappa(edesign$dis)


# Filtering genes with fold change difference 
genes.fc <- mRNA.filtered %>%
  group_by(symbol, timepoint) %>%
  summarise(avg = median(Log2TPM, na.rm = TRUE), .groups = "drop") %>%
  group_by(symbol) %>% 
  summarise(log2_fc_range = max(avg) - min(avg), .groups = "drop") %>% 
  filter(log2_fc_range > log2(1.2)) %>%  # log2(1.2) ≈ 0.26
  pull(symbol)

mRNA.lognormalized <- list.mRNA.selected[[target_tissue]][genes.fc,]

fit <- p.vector(mRNA.lognormalized, 
                edesign, 
                Q = 0.05,
                MT.adjust = "BH",
                min.obs = 6, 
                counts = FALSE,
                theta = 10
                )

tstep <- T.fit(fit)
sigs <- get.siggenes(tstep, rsq = 0.70, vars = "groups")

dir.output2 <- file.path(dir.output, "maSigPro_rsq0.7_d3")
if(!dir.exists(dir.output2)) {dir.create(dir.output2, recursive = TRUE)}

name.file <- paste0(target_tissue,"_maSigPro_mRNA_rsq0.70_hclust.k4")
svg(filename = file.path(dir.output2, paste0(name.file,".svg")))

gene.clust <- 
  see.genes(sigs$sig.genes$Group,
            show.fit = T,
            dis = edesign$dis,
            #ylim = c(3.5e+4, 1.1e+6),
            cluster.method="hclust",
            cluster.data = 1, k = 4,
            newX11 = FALSE)

dev.off()

#svg(filename = file.path(dir.output2, paste0(name.file,"_ylim.svg")))

#gene.clust <- 
#  see.genes(sigs$sig.genes$Group,
#            show.fit = T,
#            dis = edesign$dis,
#            ylim = c(3.5e+4, 1.5e+5),
#            cluster.method="hclust",
#            cluster.data = 1, k = 4,
#            newX11 = FALSE)
#
#dev.off()

sig.gene_df <- as.data.frame(gene.clust$cut)
colnames(sig.gene_df) <- "cluster" 


write.csv(sig.gene_df, 
          file = file.path(dir.output2, paste0(name.file, ".csv")))

```

```{r plot overlay, echo=TRUE}

## 1. coefficient matrix
coef_mat <- as.matrix(sigs$sig.genes$Group$coefficients)
write.csv(coef_mat, 
          file = file.path(dir.output2, "coef_mat.csv"))

## 2. transform rescaled time
time_scaled <- edesign$edesign$Time
time_day <- time_scaled * 84

## 3. GLM design matrix
X <- cbind(
  beta0     = 1,
  betaTime  = time_scaled,
  betaTime2 = time_scaled^2,
  betaTime3 = time_scaled^3
)
write.csv(X, 
          file = file.path(dir.output2, "design_mat.csv"))


## 4. fitted values: genes x samples
fitted_mat <- coef_mat %*% t(X)
colnames(fitted_mat) <- rownames(edesign$edesign)


## 5. transform to long format
sig.gene_df2 <- sig.gene_df %>% 
  rownames_to_column(var = "gene") %>% 
  mutate(cluster = factor(cluster))

fitted_df <- as.data.frame(fitted_mat)  %>% 
  rownames_to_column("gene")  %>%
  pivot_longer(
    cols = -gene,
    names_to = "sample",
    values_to = "fitted"
  )  %>%
  mutate(
    sample_index = match(sample, rownames(edesign$edesign)),
    time_scaled = time_scaled[sample_index],
    time_day = time_day[sample_index]
  )  %>%
  left_join(sig.gene_df2, by = "gene")  %>%
  filter(!is.na(cluster))

write.csv(fitted_df, 
          file = file.path(dir.output2, "fitted_df.csv"))


## 6. Average replicates every time point for each gene
fitted_gene_time <- fitted_df  %>% 
  group_by(gene, cluster, time_day) %>%
  summarise(fitted = mean(fitted), .groups = "drop")

## 8. cluster fitted curve
cluster_mean_df <- fitted_gene_time %>%
  group_by(cluster, time_day) %>%
  summarise(fitted = mean(fitted), .groups = "drop")

## 9. Plot
p <- ggplot(
  cluster_mean_df,
  aes(x = time_day, y = fitted, group = cluster)
) +
  geom_line(aes(color = cluster, linetype = cluster), linewidth = 1.2) +
  geom_point(aes(color = cluster, fill = cluster), 
             shape = 21, size = 3, stroke = 0.9) +
  theme_bw() +
  labs(
    title = target_tissue,
    x = "Time (day)",
    y = "Fitted expression",
  ) +
  scale_x_continuous(
    breaks = c(0, 1, 3, 7, 14, 28, 42, 56, 70, 84)
  ) +
  scale_color_manual(values = c(
    "1" = "#d7191c",
    "2" = "#2c7bb6",
    "3" = "#d7191c",
    "4" = "#d7191c"
  )) +

  scale_linetype_manual(values = c(
    "1" = "solid",
    "2" = "solid",
    "3" = "dashed",
    "4" = "solid"
  )) +

  scale_fill_manual(values = c(
    "1" = "#d7191c", 
    "2" = "white",
    "3" = "#d7191c",
    "4" = "#d7191c"   
  )) +
  theme(
    aspect.ratio = 1,
    plot.margin = margin(5,5,5,5),

    plot.title = element_text(size = 14, hjust = 0),

    axis.text = element_text(size = 12),

    axis.title = element_text(size = 14),

    axis.ticks = element_line(
      colour = "black",
      linewidth = 0.75
      ),
    axis.ticks.length = unit(5, "pt"),
    
    panel.border = element_rect(
      colour = "black",
      fill = NA,
      linewidth = 1
      ),
      
    legend.key = element_blank(),
    panel.grid = element_blank()
  )

p

svg(
  filename = 
    file.path(dir.output2, paste0("GLM_",target_tissue,".svg")),
  width = 4,

grid::grid.newpage()
```

# 6. Heatmap

```{r heatmap, echo=TRUE}

library(ComplexHeatmap)

mRNA.avg <- 
  mRNA.filtered %>%
  group_by(symbol, timepoint) %>%
  summarise(log2_median_TPM = median(Log2TPM, na.rm = TRUE),
            .groups = "drop") %>% 
  pivot_wider(
    names_from = "timepoint",
    values_from = "log2_median_TPM"
  ) %>% 
  
  filter(symbol %in% rownames(sig.gene_df)) %>%
  column_to_rownames(var = "symbol")


mRNA.avg.scaled <- t(mRNA.avg) %>% scale() 

tiff(filename = file.path(dir.output2, paste0("heatmap_",name.file,".tiff")),
     width = 6, height = 4, units = "in", res = 300)

  Heatmap(mRNA.avg.scaled, 
          cluster_rows = FALSE,
          cluster_columns = FALSE,
          show_column_names = FALSE,
          column_split = factor(sig.gene_df$cluster),
          column_gap = unit(1, "mm"))

dev.off()
```

```{r clustering, echo=TRUE}

for (clst_number in 1:4) {
  
  # Get genes in the cluster
  clst <- sig.gene_df %>%
    filter(cluster == clst_number) %>%
    rownames(.)
  
  # Map SYMBOL → ENTREZID and GENENAME
  clst.ids <- AnnotationDbi::select(
    x = org.Mm.eg.db,
    keys = clst,
    columns = c("ENTREZID", "GENENAME"),
    keytype = "SYMBOL"
  )
  
  # Assign object with unique name
  name.obj <- paste0("ids_clst_", clst_number)
  assign(name.obj, clst.ids, envir = .GlobalEnv)
  
  # Write CSV with clear filename
  name.file <- paste0(target_tissue,"_ids_clst_", clst_number, ".csv")
  write.csv(clst.ids, file = file.path(dir.output2, name.file), 
            row.names = FALSE)
}
```

### KEGG pathview

```{r pathview, echo=TRUE}

library(pathview)

input.name <- lapply(1:4, function(i) {
  name <- paste0("ids_clst_",i)
  return(name)
  }) %>% unlist()

list.kegg <- setNames( 
  
  lapply(input.name, function(input){
  
  obj <- get(input, envir = .GlobalEnv)
  
  dir.save <- file.path(dir.output2, "kegg", input)
  if(!dir.exists(dir.save)) {dir.create(dir.save, recursive = TRUE)}
  setwd(dir.save)
  
  kegg <-
    enrichKEGG(gene = obj$ENTREZID,
               organism = "mmu",
               universe = mRNA.anno$ENTREZID,
               pvalueCutoff = 0.05,
               qvalueCutoff = 0.05,
               pAdjustMethod = "BH"
               )
  kegg@result$Description <- sub(" - Mus musculus \\(house mouse\\)$", "",
                                 kegg@result$Description)
  
  path <- kegg@result %>% 
    filter(qvalue < 0.05) %>% 
    pull(ID) %>% 
    as.vector()
  
  lapply(path, function(pw) {
    try(
    pathview(gene.data = ids.avg.centered, 
             pathway.id = pw,
             species = "mmu",
             kegg.native = TRUE,
             high = list(gene = "#A11A5BFF"),
             low = list(gene = "#7AD151FF"),
             out.suffix = paste0(target_tissue, "_", input)),
    silent = TRUE
  )
  })

  df <- as.data.frame(kegg@result)
  
  df <- df %>%
  # Reset rownames if necessary
  tibble::rownames_to_column(var = "row_id") %>%
  # Split geneID column into individual gene IDs
  separate_rows(geneID, sep = "/", convert = TRUE) %>%
  
  rename(geneID = "entrezid")
  
  mRNA.anno$entrezid <- as.numeric(mRNA.anno$entrezid) 
  
  df <- left_join(
    x = df,
    y = mRNA.anno,
    by = "entrezid"
    )
  
  name.save <- paste0(target_tissue, "_kegg_", input)
  
  write.csv(
    x = df,
    file = file.path(dir.output2, paste0(name.save,".csv"))
    )
  
   if (!is.null(kegg) && nrow(as.data.frame(kegg)) > 0) {
      dotplot(kegg) +
        labs(title = paste0(target_tissue, "_KEGGPathway_", input)) +
        theme(aspect.ratio = 2/1)
    } else {
      NULL
    }
}),
input.name
)

list.kegg <- Filter(function(x) inherits(x, "gg"), list.kegg)
 if (length(list.kegg) > 0) {
  combined_plot <- 
    patchwork::wrap_plots(list.kegg,
                          ncol = length(list.kegg))
  
  name.save <- paste0(target_tissue, "_keggPath")
  svg(filename = file.path(dir.output2, paste0(name.save, ".svg")),
      width = 20, height = 13.5)
  print(combined_plot)
  dev.off()
} else {
  message("No enriched KEGGPathways found. No plot saved.")
}

setwd(wd)
```

## 7.2. GO enrichment

```{r go, echo=TRUE}

lapply(input.name, function(input) {
  
  obj <- get(input, envir = .GlobalEnv)
  ont <- c("BP", "MF", "CC")

  GO <- setNames(
    lapply(ont, function(ont) {
      ego <- enrichGO(
        gene = obj$ENTREZID,
        OrgDb = org.Mm.eg.db,
        ont = ont,
        universe = mRNA.anno$ENTREZID,
        pvalueCutoff = 0.05,
        qvalueCutoff = 0.05,
        pAdjustMethod = "BH",
        readable = TRUE
      )

      if (!is.null(ego) && nrow(as.data.frame(ego)) > 0) {
        ego <- simplify(ego)
        ego <- pairwise_termsim(ego)
        name.save <- paste0(target_tissue,"_GO_", ont, "_", input) 
        write.csv(as.data.frame(ego), 
                  file = file.path(dir.output2, paste0(name.save, ".csv")))
        return(ego)
      } else {
        message("No enriched terms for ", ont, " in ", input)
        return(NULL)
      }
    }),
    ont
  )

  # Create dotplots only for non-null enrichments
  list.plot <- list()
  for (term in ont) {
    if (!is.null(GO[[term]])) {
      p <- dotplot(GO[[term]]) +
        labs(title = paste0(target_tissue, "_GO_", term, "_", input)) +
        theme(aspect.ratio = 2 / 1)
      list.plot[[term]] <- p
    }
  }

  if (length(list.plot) > 0) {
    
    name.save <- paste0(target_tissue, "_GO_", input)
    
    svg(filename = file.path(dir.output2, paste0(name.save, ".svg")),
         width = 24, height = 13.5)
    
    print(patchwork::wrap_plots(list.plot, ncol = length(list.plot)))

    dev.off()
  } else {
    message("No plots created for ", input)
  }
})
```

### 7.2.2 Heatmap of module score

```{r ms, echo=TRUE}

# input data
## gene-wise standarized (mean = 0, sd = 1)
zscore <- t(scale(t(mRNA.lognormalized))) 
zscore[is.na(zscore)] <- 0

rowMeans(zscore)  
apply(zscore,1,sd)

# meta data
sample_names <- colnames(zscore)

timepoint <- sub(paste0(target_tissue,"_([^_]+)_.*$", "\\1"), sample_names)
timepoint
time_levels <- c("0d","1d","3d","1w","2w","4w","6w","8w","10w","12w")
timepoint <- factor(timepoint, levels = time_levels)

# test GO terms selected from GO enrichment analysis for clustered significant genes
go_list <- lapply(1:4, function(nr) {

  f <- file.path(dir.output2, 
                 paste0(target_tissue,"_GO_BP_ids_clst_", nr, ".csv"))

  if (!file.exists(f)) {
    message("File not found, skipping: ", f)
    return(NULL)
  }

  read.csv(f, stringsAsFactors = FALSE)
})

## select the top 10 GO terms for each cluster in order of p.adjust 
go_ids <- lapply(go_list, function(df) head(x = df[,"ID"], 10))
names(go_ids) <- paste0("cluster", seq_along(go_ids))

go_to_genes <- function(go_id) {
  out <- AnnotationDbi::select(
    org.Mm.eg.db,
    keys = go_id,
    keytype = "GOALL",
    columns = "SYMBOL"
  )
  unique(na.omit(out$SYMBOL))
}

## gene sets of each selected GO terms
go_gene_sets <- lapply(go_ids, function(ids) {
  sets <- lapply(ids, go_to_genes)
  names(sets) <- ids
  sets
})

# Culculate module scores in each replicate
module_scores_by_cluster <- lapply(go_gene_sets, function(go_list) {

  # Keep only GO terms with >= 3 genes present in expression matrix
  go_list_filtered <- lapply(go_list, function(g) {
    intersect(g, rownames(zscore))
  })

  go_list_filtered <- go_list_filtered[
    sapply(go_list_filtered, length) >= 3
  ]

  # If nothing remains, return empty matrix
  if (length(go_list_filtered) == 0) {
    return(NULL)
  }

  # Compute module scores
  sapply(go_list_filtered, function(g) {
    colMeans(zscore[g, , drop = FALSE], na.rm = TRUE)
  })
})


# Calculate module scores in every time point
## function

avg_by_time <- function(mat, 
                        prefix = target_tissue,
                        time_levels = time_levels) {
  stopifnot(is.matrix(mat))

  tp <- sub(paste0("^", prefix, "_([^_]+)_.*$"), "\\1", rownames(mat))
  tp <- factor(tp, levels = time_levels)

  # average rows (replicates) within each timepoint -> returns GO_terms × timepoints
  out <- sapply(levels(tp), function(x) {
    rows <- which(tp == x)
    colMeans(mat[rows, , drop = FALSE], na.rm = TRUE)
  })

  # name timepoint columns
  colnames(out) <- levels(tp)
  out
}

# keep only non-empty clusters
module_scores_nonempty <- module_scores_by_cluster[sapply(module_scores_by_cluster, length) > 0]

module_by_time_by_cluster <- lapply(module_scores_nonempty, avg_by_time)
module_by_time_by_cluster <- lapply(module_by_time_by_cluster, function(mat) {
  mat[, time_levels, drop=FALSE]
})


normalize_rows <- function(mat) {
  z <- t(scale(t(mat)))
  z[is.na(z)] <- 0
  z
}

module_by_time_norm <- lapply(module_by_time_by_cluster, normalize_rows)

mat_all <- do.call(rbind, module_by_time_norm)

row_group <- factor(
  rep(names(module_by_time_norm),
      times = sapply(module_by_time_norm, nrow)),
  levels = names(module_by_time_norm)
  )

col_fun <- circlize::colorRamp2(c(-2, 0, 2), c("#2c7bb6", "white", "#d7191c"))

n_row <- nrow(mat_all)
n_col <- ncol(mat_all)
cell_size <- unit(6, "mm")

ht <- Heatmap(
  mat_all,
  name = "Module\nscore",
  col = col_fun,

  # keep time order fixed
  cluster_columns = FALSE,

  # group rows by cluster, and cluster within each group
  row_split = row_group,
  cluster_rows = TRUE,
  cluster_row_slices = FALSE,   # don't reorder the cluster blocks

  # Make each tile square
  
  width = n_col * cell_size,
  height = n_row * cell_size,
  
  # cosmetics
  show_row_names = TRUE,
  row_names_side = "left",
  row_names_gp = gpar(fontsize = 8),
  column_names_gp = gpar(fontsize = 10),
  border = FALSE,
  heatmap_legend_param = list(at = c(-2, -1, 0, 1, 2))
)

# heatmap body size
body_w_in <- convertWidth(n_col * cell_size, "in", valueOnly = TRUE)
body_h_in <- convertHeight(n_row * cell_size, "in", valueOnly = TRUE)

# extra space for rownames + legend + titles (tweak if needed)
extra_left_in  <- 2.5
extra_right_in <- 2.0
extra_top_in   <- 1.0
extra_bot_in   <- 0.5

svg(
  file.path(dir.output2,"GO_module_heatmap.svg"),
  width  = body_w_in + extra_left_in + extra_right_in,
  height = body_h_in + extra_top_in + extra_bot_in
)

draw(
  ht,
  heatmap_legend_side = "right",
  annotation_legend_side = "right",
  #padding = unit(c(6, 6, 6, 6), "mm")  # top, right, bottom, left padding inside device
)

dev.off()

draw(ht)
```

## 7.3. WikiPathway

```{r wp, echo=TRUE}

wiki <- setNames(
  lapply(input.name, function(input) {
    obj <- get(input, envir = .GlobalEnv)
    
    wp <- enrichWP(gene = obj$ENTREZID, organism = "Mus musculus")
    
    # Save CSV even if empty (for auditing)
    name.obj <- paste0(target_tissue,"_wp_", input, ".csv")
    write.csv(as.data.frame(wp), file = file.path(dir.output2, name.obj))
    
    # Return plot only if enrichment result is not empty
    if (!is.null(wp) && nrow(as.data.frame(wp)) > 0) {
      dotplot(wp) +
        labs(title = paste0(target_tissue,"_WikiPathway_", input)) +
        theme(aspect.ratio = 2/1)
    } else {
      NULL
    }
  }),
  names(input.name)
)

# Remove NULL entries (failed enrichments)
wiki <- Filter(Negate(is.null), wiki)

# Only attempt to save if we have any plots
if (length(wiki) > 0) {
  combined_plot <- patchwork::wrap_plots(wiki, ncol = length(wiki))

  svg(filename = file.path(dir.output2, 
                           paste0(target_tissue, "_WikiPathay.svg")),
       width = 24, height = 13.5)
  print(combined_plot)
  dev.off()
} else {
  message("No enriched WikiPathways found. No plot saved.")
}

```
